change.title: Establish the durable one-click compensation journal foundation
change.summary: Publishes a separate path-free aggregate compensation intent by exact business-record CAS before the first compensation effect, preserves it while restoring the pre-operation runtime transaction, and either clears it after complete compensation or persists unique typed failed steps.

basis: Config owns a separate path-free RuntimeCompensationJournal so authority restore can recover the exact pre-operation runtime_transaction without erasing the compensation crash marker or copying prior-stop paths

begin_one_click_compensation covers both Journaled and PreJournalAbort progress and publishes in_progress by exact business-record CAS before Science cleanup, SSH cleanup, authority restore, prior Science restart, or snapshot cleanup
authority restore requires both the exact active runtime transaction and exact compensation record, restores captured config, then overlays only the compensation record

finish_one_click_compensation checks the exact marker plus an allowed pre-restore or restored business record, clears only after complete compensation, or persists incomplete with unique typed failed_steps

one-click entry, normal mode/settings/profile/Codex auth/settings/downgrade mutation guards, selection projection, and finalize read model treat either runtime transaction or compensation journal as open
explicit stop_all, quit, and native-exit cleanup remain available because they reduce runtime exposure and do not mutate config or credentials
focused schema, CAS, source-contract, credential-redaction, snapshot-cleanup, and prior-restart regressions cover the new boundary
fresh-process compensation replay, per-step intent/outcome, artifact, installed/live, provider, Science, SSH, signing, and release proof remain excluded
